description: H.G. Abeyratne v. M.I.M. Farook H.G. Abeyratne v. M.I.M. Farook View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: H.G. Abeyratne v. M.I.M. Farook H.G. Abeyratne v. M.I.M. Farook View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court order setting aside an ex parte judgement subject to prepayment of costs in a rent and ejectment action, despite Respondent’s repeated absences. Held - Although Respondent’s conduct contributed to delay, his counsel’s genuine illness was excusable ground for non-appearance. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
